repos.name: beenuar/AiSOC
repos.description: Open-source AI Security Operations Center: alert fusion, LLM-agent triage, MITRE ATT&CK investigation, and a replayable decision ledger for every agent step. Self-hostable, runs with no API keys, MIT licensed. Ships an MCP server for Claude, Cursor and Continue.
repos.one_liner: An open-source AI-driven Security Operations Center for automated threat triage and investigation.
bullets: Built with Python, focusing on alert fusion and MITRE ATT&CK framework integration.
Features LLM-agent triage and a replayable decision ledger for auditability.
Designed for self-hosting with zero external API key dependencies for privacy.
Ideal for security teams automating incident response and threat hunting workflows.

repos.name: snchimata/tokenfold
repos.description: Private, provider-neutral context compression for LLMs. Reversibly compress schemas and logs inside your perimeter with zero third-party calls.
repos.one_liner: A private, provider-neutral context compression tool for LLMs.
bullets: Written in Rust to ensure high-performance, memory-safe context processing.
Compresses schemas and logs locally within the user's perimeter.
Supports reversible compression to maintain data integrity without third-party calls.
Useful for developers optimizing LLM token usage and reducing latency in agentic pipelines.
repos.img_alt: Terminal demo: Python fit() code and verified 2,366 to 1,376 token savings from the first frame, followed by Core-first processing and optional Tokenfold Select. Select illustration only.

repos.name: dotnet/skills
repos.description: Repository for skills to assist AI coding agents with .NET and C#
repos.one_liner: A collection of specialized skills designed to assist AI coding agents in the .NET ecosystem.
bullets: Developed in C# to provide native integration with .NET development environments.
Provides structured tool definitions for agents to perform complex code analysis and refactoring.
Standardizes how AI agents interact with .NET projects, libraries, and build tools.
Essential for enterprise teams building custom AI-assisted coding infrastructure.

repos.name: vercel-labs/ui
repos.description: A library of behaviors for agents to build the next generation of user interfaces.
repos.one_liner: A library of behavioral primitives designed for AI agents to interact with modern user interfaces.
bullets: TypeScript-based library focused on agent-to-UI communication patterns.
Provides the building blocks for agents to navigate, manipulate, and interpret web interfaces.
Enables the next generation of autonomous UI-driven workflows.
Targeted at developers building agentic systems that require browser-based interaction.

repos.name: 514-labs/dnsglobe
repos.description: Global DNS propagation checker TUI — watch a DNS record propagate across 34 public resolvers worldwide, on a world map in your terminal
repos.one_liner: A terminal-based global DNS propagation checker with a real-time world map visualization.
bullets: Written in Rust for high-speed, concurrent network requests.
Monitors DNS record propagation across 34 public resolvers worldwide.
Provides a TUI (Terminal User Interface) for rapid infrastructure debugging.
Useful for DevOps and SREs managing global traffic routing and DNS configuration changes.
repos.img_alt: dnsglobe demo — checking A and NS records for a domain across 34 resolvers worldwide with EDNS Client Subnet, cycling the client subnet, then morphing the world map into a rotating globe
